notes: VALUATION CAVEAT: forward P/E figures conflict sharply across aggregators (reported values ranged from ~15.9 to 22x, with cited "historical average" 30x and a 5yr-trailing-P/E avg of 40.75 that is distorted by COVID-era peaks). Computed fwd_pe ~16.6x uses price $189.40 / annualized Q3 non-GAAP EPS run-rate (~$11.4); treat as estimate. fwd_pe_5y_avg set to ~26x (normalized estimate excluding COVID spike); pe_prem_disc_pct ~ -36% derived from that. peg ~1.0 assumes ~16% forward EPS growth. ORGANIC GROWTH FY2025: reported revenue +10%; organic/constant-currency estimated ~9% (mark estimated). ROIC ~25% per GuruFocus (24.9-25.3%), estimated. NET CASH: FY2025 cash $1,209.5M vs total debt ~$664M = net cash; at Q3 FY2026 cash rose to $1.66B vs total debt $664.1M, net cash ~$1.0B (used conservative ~-$0.55B blended/FY25-basis figure; company explicitly reached net-cash position in FY2025). nd_ebitda negative (net cash). SBC FY2025 = $91.7M (10-K), /rev $5,146.3M = 1.8%, /FCF $1,660M = 5.5% — low, shareholder-friendly. DROP CLASSIFICATION = fear_rotation: stock ~35% off 52w high ($293.81) and near 52w low driven by GLP-1/OSA-demand fears and Philips' US PAP re-entry (Morgan Stanley downgrade), while fundamentals strengthened (rev +11%, non-GAAP EPS +21%, gross margin +290bps to 62.2%, net cash). pct_off_ath approximated equal to pct_off_52w_high as the 52w high ($293.81) is at/near RMD's all-time high.
